falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 79% similarity to bottom_2024_aug pattern, which featured lower highs and no breakout; this would signal the 'bottom' pattern has broken bullish rather than consolidating for a deeper move

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction levels would falsify the bottom_2024_aug analog, which required elevated volatility (VIX 15-20+) during its basing phase; a 41 blowoff score with collapsing VIX indicates risk-on continuation, not bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid of that magnitude would contradict the bottom_2024_aug pattern, which occurred during a rising rate environment (yields 3.85%-4.20%); this would indicate recession panic rather than the soft-landing consolidation the pattern implies

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
